description: Render a Templated template into an image (JPG, PNG or WebP), a PDF or an MP4 video, with new text, images and colors in its layers. Use this when the user wants a finished design from one of their templates, such as a social media post, banner, OG image, certificate or invoice. Templated fills the saved template with the exact values given: this is template rendering, not AI image generation. Pass the template ID and 'layers' keyed by the layer names from get_template_layers; names the template doesn't have are rejected before anything is rendered. Multi-page templates render every page, or only the pages listed in 'pages'. Each output counts toward the account's render usage. Returns the render with its file URL (one render per page for multi-page templates).

duration.description: Video duration in milliseconds (MP4 only, max 90000)

layers.description: Layer values keyed by layer name, e.g. { "title": { "text": "Hello" }, "photo": { "image_url": "https://..." } }. Each value can set text, image_url, color, background, hide and other layer properties. 'animation' (MP4 only) takes 'in' (entrance: type slide|fade|zoom|rotate, direction, duration, writingStyle), 'loop' (type spin|pulse, duration), 'out' (exit: type slide|fade|zoom, direction, duration), 'start' and 'end' (when the layer appears and disappears). All animation times are in milliseconds.

pages.description: For multi-page templates: the pages to render, each with its own layer values. Each item has 'page' (a page name from get_template_pages) and 'layers' keyed by layer name, like the top-level 'layers'. Only the listed pages are rendered. Use either 'layers' or 'pages' in one call.

layers.description: Layer values for this page, keyed by layer name

page.description: Page name, as returned by get_template_pages

template.description: The template ID to render (from list_templates)

name: create_render

editorUrl.description: Link to edit the template in the Templated editor

format.description: jpg, png, webp, pdf or mp4

renders.description: Present when the call produced several renders (one per page); single renders put their fields at the top level

format.description: jpg, png, webp, pdf or mp4

status.description: completed, pending or failed; for several renders, pending while any of them is
